note: Where sources disagree. Both positions are kept with their sources; `resolution.status` is RESOLVED only when a document in hand settles it (and says which), VARIANT when the evidence of each drawing decides, EDITION_DEPENDENT when the governing edition is not established, OPEN otherwise. `affects` names what the resolution governs: documented formulas and constants (their status in formulas.json), rules, concepts, and errata appended to the vendored drafting skills when they are served.

positions.claim: 0.762 m, 'IRS (BG standard)', bound as a constant
depends on rail, sleeper and ballast; an ASSUMPTION

conflicts.evidence: A drawing in hand shows 0.688 on an existing line and 0.762 on the proposed one; the legacy slab engine used 0.738.

resolution.decision: Each track's own rail and formation levels; 0.762 is never bound as a constant or enforced as a check.

skills.erratum: rail = formation + 0.762 is an ASSUMPTION (knowledge KC-1), never a check: each track's rail and formation levels are read, and their difference is reported, not enforced.

sources.note: FORM-GEO-004; the drawing is not in hand

resolution.decision: The documented formula contradicts itself and is never applied. The geometric identity FW + 2·s·H (end height, bank slope s) holds for a straight bank; barrel length stays a design input.

conflicts.evidence: Drawings in hand use a 200 × 200 haunch.

resolution.decision: No minimum is checked; the haunch is a design input or a reading.

positions.claim: box height = cH + tST + tSB: the clear height runs from the structural floor
box height = cH + tST + tSB + t_wear: the clear height runs from the wearing-course top

conflicts.evidence: A drawing in hand writes bed level and bottom-of-slab levels whose difference equals the written clear height, with a wearing course in the cell.

resolution.decision: Both are geometry; which one a drawing uses is decided by its written levels (layout clear_from, derived when the levels decide it). Without that evidence the recipes' established convention (from the floor) is used and reported as assumed.

positions.claim: datum of 'fill height' (formation, sleeper or rail) unverified; ≥ 300 mm (tier 3)

resolution.decision: The drawing's cushion is formation − top of structure (a definition); no minimum is checked.

conflicts.topic: HFL vs the design-discharge water level

positions.claim: HFL aliases DFL / DESIGN FLOOD LEVEL
distinct: clearance and free board are measured from the water level of Q incl. afflux; HFL is a survey fact

resolution.decision: Distinct concepts (hfl, design_water_level). A drawing's F.B. / CL- written against the HFL is read as written; the IRBM 313 check against the HFL is an indication only (REQUIRES REVIEW).
IRBM-2024 604(1)(b)(c), page 69 (the document in hand). The 603 citation belongs to the 1998 edition.
The documented values are BS-118 as written; whether the 2020 code governs the project is not established. Not enforced.
Not applied; box and pipe culverts are exempt from seismic analysis anyway (BS-118 4.4).
IRBM-2024 403(2), page 46: other bridges on open foundations, ordinary soil; pipe and box culverts are 402.

skills.erratum: the 1.75 m open-foundation rule is IRBM-2024 para 403(2) (page 46), for bridges other than pipe and box culverts — not 316(2).

positions.claim: minimum clear span 1 m, headroom 1.2 m

resolution.decision: IRBM-2024 311(3), page 41: clear span ≥ 1 m (new and rebuilt); headroom ≥ 1.2 m in new bridges, relaxable by PCE/CBE.

positions.claim: 1 m × 1 m, 'staggered' unverified; IPWE 1.5 m horizontal

resolution.decision: IRBM-2024 605(3) (1 m vertical and horizontal, staggered) and 207(3) (lowest row above LWL in streams, 250 mm above bed otherwise, above FSL in canals).
No formation width is assumed; it is read or it is absent.

positions.claim: linear interpolation within the bands; 5% above 25,000 km², NORMATIVE
bands only; interpolation not stated; above 25,000 km² 'less than 10% at CBE discretion'

resolution.decision: The IRBM bands; the interpolation is UNKNOWN and is not assumed.

positions.claim: clearance by discharge table (600–1800 mm) from the design water level; 1.0 m is the free board

resolution.decision: IRBM 312(1) table for clearance (not for box / pipe culverts, 312(3)); IRBM 313 for free board.

positions.claim: depth ≥ L/12 plate girder, L/10 truss; L/20, L/16 are spacing ratios

resolution.decision: Not checked.

conflicts.topic: Seismic exemption and arch limits wording

positions.claim: 4.5(a): zones II & III, overall length < 60 m OR spans < 15 m; 4.3: masonry / PCC arches > 12 m not in zones IV and V
L ≤ 60 AND span ≤ 15 outside IV/V; arch limits by zone differ

resolution.decision: BS-118 is quoted as written; the governing edition is for the engineer to state.

positions.claim: B-10155 / B-10158 sheet counts and spans

resolution.decision: No sheet is in hand; no dimension from any standard drawing is executable.

positions.claim: 1 in 100 and D/40 ≤ 150 mm (railway) vs 1 in 80, 150 mm (IRC / IS)

resolution.decision: IRBM-2024 424(1)(a), page 57: tilt up to 1 in 100 and shift D/40 subject to 150 mm, for railway wells. The road values belong to another authority.

positions.claim: unverified; tier-3 curtain ≥ 2.0 m, drop ≥ 2.5 m

resolution.decision: IRBM-2024 818, page 106: minor bridges — drop wall depth 1.25 × D_Lacey; the floor covers abutments and wing walls.
IRBM-2024 409(2)–(4), page 48: ≥ 2.5d end bearing, ≥ 3d friction, 2d possible in loose sand.

conflicts.topic: Minimum clear height of a box

positions.claim: headroom ≥ 1.2 m in new bridges, relaxable

resolution.decision: IRBM-2024 311(3) (rule IRBM-311-3-HEADROOM); RCR-VAL-003 is not applied.
